item.title: ARK Tides of Fortune
item.description:
Title: ARK Tides of Fortune
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , Massively Multiplayer , RPG
Developer: Studio Wildcard
Publisher: Studio Wildcard , Snail Games USA
Franchise: Snail Games USA
Release Date: Jul 3, 2026




About This Content

Pull up a chair, Survivors. Everyone knows the legendary ARK veteran Bob - played by Karl Urban - but you haven't truly heard a tale until you've survived his swashbuckling exploits on the high seas. Hoist the sails and experience his next chapter of incredibly true adventures in ARK Tides of Fortune!

The simulated ocean of Genesis Ascended Part 1 has opened into a massive, map-wide nautical frontier. Chart a course across a vast sea, hunt for buried treasure, and clash with treacherous enemies in explosive naval combat. The new weapons, structures, cosmetics, and exotic creatures included in Tides of Fortune can be unleashed across the ARK universe, but the deep physics-driven waters of Genesis are where this swashbuckling arsenal truly comes alive.

NAVAL WARFARE:

  • Naval Fleet: Construct customizable seaworthy vessels at the Shipyard, including the swift Sloop and the towering Brigantine. Transform your ship into a true floating fortress by building out the decks, painting the hull, flying your own Jolly Roger, and sailing into battle with sea shanties ringing over the roar of cannon fire!

  • Ship Combat: Take the helm to manually aim and fire your broadside cannons, either solo or as a cooperative multiplayer team! Utilize specialty ammo like Incendiary and Corrosive Cannonballs to give enemy armadas no quarter and send them to Davy Jones’ locker - all without micromanaging a crew.

  • Ship Skill Tree: Customize your vessel's seafaring capabilities by investing your plunder across three distinct skill trees: Piracy, Merchant, and Luxury.

NEW CREATURES:

  • Tidepup: As adorable as it is invaluable, this benevolent semi-aquatic salamander specializes in support, protection, and healing. Keep it as a Juvenile shoulder-pet to defend against incoming damage and dispel negative effects, or evolve it into a Mature rideable mount capable of creating a regenerative healing zone for your allies.

  • Parrot: Your new feathery friend tracks valuable treasure sources like Cave Crates, Alpha Creatures, and enemy Ships. And by completing missions together, your Parrot can also earn Bonding Feathers, a wildcard resource which substitutes any imprint or passive tame requirement, with effectiveness scaling from your Parrot’s stats.

A CINEMATIC SAGA:

  • Cinematic Cutscenes & Milestones: Track your survivor's journey through entirely new Milestones! Prove your mastery across a wide range of challenges - from commanding naval fleets and unearthing treasure, to conquering Genesis gauntlets and taming powerful X-Creatures. Achieve these milestones to earn points for deep specialization skill trees, while hitting major thresholds unlocks spectacular cinematic sequences starring Karl Urban as Bob and Auli'i Cravalho as Meeka, continuing the narrative into ARK’s future!

  • Play as a Legend: Step directly into the boots of the myth himself! Tides of Fortune adds a third default character creation option, allowing you to play as ""Cinematic Bob"" - featuring the likeness and voice of Karl Urban. You can also equip Bob's signature look as a full-body cosmetic costume to bring his legendary style to your existing Survivor. All existing costumes, armor, hairstyles, and other cosmetics are compatible with Cinematic Bob!

NEW WEAPONS & TOOLS:

  • Hand Cannon: A brutal, single-shot firearm loaded with unique Grapeshot ammo. It excels at close-quarters deck clearing, delivering massive knockback to forcibly launch boarding enemies and creatures right into the drink!

  • Shovel: Bring your trusty shovel to sandy shores to unearth buried treasure caches revealed by drifting Treasure Map Bottles found across the ocean.

NEW STRUCTURES:

  • Shipyard: A massive water-based drydock used to construct and deploy your majestic fleet.

  • Aquatic Compartment: Build custom, water-filled enclosed rooms on land to breed your aquatic beasts or design the ultimate submerged smuggler's den.

  • Cargo Ledger: Keep your plunder in shipshape order! This central logistics hub ties all your nearby storage crates together, letting you effortlessly track, organize, and pull exactly what you need from across your entire pirate haven.

  • Market: Set up your own map-wide bazaar! This player-driven trading post lets you peddle your plunder, establish buy and sell orders, and cut deals using Hexagons. It also acts as an offshore Hexchange, giving you direct access to the HLN-A store across any ARK.

  • Bounty Board: Turn your tribe into a crew of hired guns! This mission hub issues shared, repeatable dynamically-generated contracts to hunt down designated targets in exchange for a hefty haul of Hexagons.

  • Fish Tank: Showcase your rarest ocean catches in an ornate aquarium adorned with detailing and customizable aquascapes, turning your favorite finds from the deep into a striking nautical centerpiece.

TREASURE HUNTS & ENCOUNTERS:

  • High Seas Encounters: Take the fight to the open water! Engage in explosive ship-to-ship combat against hostile ships, then breach and sabotage massive Ocean Outposts in thrilling, multi-phase fortress raids.

NEW COSMETICS & TILESETS:

  • Structure Skins: Fully customize your pirate haven with the new Spanish Colonial Architecture tileset. Decorate your captain's quarters with pirate-themed storage boxes, a Hammock Bed, a Captain's Desk, oil lamps, and more!

  • Player Outfits: Dress the part of a true buccaneer with the Scurvy, Fancy, or Captain Pirate outfits.

  • Accessories: Complete your seaworthy look with the Eye Patch, Peg Leg, and a razor-sharp Cutlass Sword skin.

Every daring voyage begins with a map, a ship, and a fortune waiting beyond the horizon. Build your fleet, raise your colors, and boldly go to carve your legend across the ocean’s tides!

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K

item.title: ARK: Dragontopia
item.description:
Title: ARK: Dragontopia
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , Massively Multiplayer , RPG
Developer: Studio Wildcard
Publisher: Studio Wildcard , Snail Games USA
Franchise: Snail Games USA
Release Date: Jul 3, 2026




About This Content

Tame the legends and rule the skies!

Awaken within a cloudbound paradise where the earth has fractured into a world of floating islands, and myths take flight. High above these magical grounds, Survivors must learn a new rhythm of survival alongside the true rulers of the sky: the dragons. Across a vast aerial ecosystem, ARK: Dragontopia invites you to step off the edge and master the skies. Guided by the echoes of a lost order of dragonriders, enter a land where legends breathe anew. As a fierce new threat claims the horizon, it is up to you to restore balance!

LORDS OF THE SKY

Between the sun and moon, the skies teem with draconic legends. Encounter titanic behemoths that devour resources and enemies alike, and elegant, wind-dancing steeds that gallop across the clouds. From deadly four-winged assassins, to multi-headed beasts of dual-breathed chaos, and loyal shoulder-drakes that guard you on your journey, every dragon in this realm demands its own path to taming. You’ll need to observe, learn, and master each of these temperamental creatures’ unique rhythms before they ever let you take the saddle.

THE DRAGONTOPIA ECOSYSTEM

To survive this new high-altitude frontier, you’ll need to grow through the Dragon Skill Trees, a new progression system built around strengthening your bond with these mythical beasts. Craft highly specialized gear and wield potent tools, and expand your base with a draconic tileset, incubator backpacks, and mysterious potion stations. But the skies are actively contested, and you are the realm's last hope to break the vanguard of a ruthless airborne invader!

AVAILABLE NOW

Eclipsar Umbra , the legendary obsidian terror born to claim the night sky. Bound to your will through the mythic Dragon Horn, this shadow-forged executioner strikes with terrifying, unpredictable speed. Rain precision plasma from the cover of darkness, or slip through the void itself to ambush unsuspecting prey. As his fury builds in the heat of combat, Umbra awakens his ultimate form - a blinding surge of raw energy that shatters enemy defenses and renders him a near-untouchable terror of the skies.

Dragon Skill Tree unlocks a brand-new progression path that lets you forge a deeper bond with your dragons. Push the limits of their gravity-defying acrobatics, amplify their shadow-forged plasma attacks, or tailor their defensive auras, as you shape the ultimate apex predator around your exact playstyle.

Drake Claw Grappler: Wield this essential new tool for high-altitude traversal and midair dragon mounting.

  • Draconic Armor: Equip this cosmetic set and look every inch the legendary dragonrider.

THE FLIGHT PLAN

Your journey into the clouds is just beginning. Secure Dragontopia now and you’re locked in for a massive rollout of content over the coming months:

  • July: Lumina awakens! Umbra’s sun-sworn counterpart takes flight to restore celestial balance. Scatter brilliant celestial traps to punish your pursuers, or bend light itself to vanish in a flash and outmaneuver any threat. When pushed to the brink, Lumina erupts into her ultimate sun-flare state - stripping away technological defenses and rising as a blazing sovereign of the clouds. When united in battle with her shadowedkin, their celestial synergy ignites, forging an unstoppable alliance of speed, armor, and destruction.

  • October: A colossal sky-behemoth rises. This heavily armored juggernaut dominates the clouds by inhaling everything in its path, drawing resources, enemies, and even allies into its cavernous maw. It can weaponize its consumed payload, violently expelling it as a devastating barrage to scatter targets below. As it consumes the battlefield, its sheer mass swells to absorb incoming fire, allowing it to anchor down and become an immovable bulwark against any siege.

  • December: Prepare to take flight into a boundless, map-wide skyworld. Explore fantastical floating landmasses surrounded by countless procedural shattered isles, unlock the secrets of aerial phenomena, conquer enemy outposts, gain a tremendous variety of new items, new vehicles, and cosmetics, and most important of all: bond with the complete mythical roster of dragons! Repel the onslaught of a merciless invading legion, and face off against an apex threat unlike anything ARK has ever seen!

The dragons are waking, the islands are calling, and the Skies of Dragontopia are yours to claim!

item.title: Master Healer Kale with useless party
item.description:
Title: Master Healer Kale with useless party
Genre: Indie , RPG , Strategy
Developer: Evrac Studio
Publisher: Evrac Studio
Release Date: Jul 2, 2026




About This Game

Play as Kale, the Master Healer, on his journey to defeat the Demon King who terrorizes the Kingdom. Your main job is to keep your party alive by healing or buffing them. Accompanied by a tank who is always sleeping, a newbie archer, and a genius but mean magic user.

=== Keep your party alive ===

As a healer, it's your job to heal your party and keep them alive.

=== Upgrade Kale's healing spells or party's stats ===

You can upgrade Kale's ability to heal or your party's damage, maximum health, and other stats in a massive skill tree.

=== Defeat giant Boss ===

Eventually, your party will be able to defeat bosses (and maybe the Demon King itself).

=== Enjoy the fireworks ===

Well, your party is not so useless after all...

Features

  • Massive skill tree (200+ upgrades)

  • 18 active spells to support the party

  • 16+ different dungeons

  • Fight bosses with different strategies

  • Short gameplay (~4 hours of playtime)

  • Challenge post-game for more content

item.title: Supermarket Chaos
item.description:
Title: Supermarket Chaos
Genre: Indie , Simulation
Developer: BunnyHop
Publisher: BunnyHopHome
Release Date: Jun 29, 2026




About This Game

Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator about calmly putting a chaotic supermarket back in order. Arrange 4,668 products across 16 sections, including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every shelf feel right.

〖A Relaxing Supermarket Organizing Simulator〗

One day, the store-organizing robot GPT-9000 reached a philosophical conclusion: “All positions are temporary, and all displays are violence.” As a result, every product in the supermarket lost its place. (Fortunately, he was fired immediately.)

No need to worry. Now all you have to do is walk through the quiet store and return each scattered product to its proper place.

〖When a Messy Store Falls Into Place〗

At first, the store is a little chaotic.
Empty shelves, products left on the floor, sections that still need attention.
But as you put each item back where it belongs, the store gradually becomes a clean, comfortable space.

〖Pick Up Products, Find Their Sections, and Put Them in Place〗

Pick up each product, find the right section, and match it to the correct price tag.
Instead of rushing, settle into the rhythm of organizing and take your time completing the store.

〖One Completed Section, One Quiet Satisfaction〗

Empty shelves fill up with products, and mixed-up items settle into neat rows.
Each completed section brings visible progress and a quiet sense of satisfaction.

〖Skill Upgrades〗

Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play.
Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient.

〖Key Features〗

  • A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products

  • 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more

  • Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong

  • The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

  • A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

All 3D models, music, and UI icons were created by humans. Generative AI was used for some in-game textures, localization, and translation.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790k / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 Ti 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 6500XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 2 GB available space

Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play.
Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient.

〖Key Features〗

  • A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products

  • 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more

  • Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong

  • The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

  • A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

All 3D models, music, and UI icons were created by humans. Generative AI was used for some in-game textures, localization, and translation.

item.description:
Title: EMPULSE
Genre: Action , Early Access
Developer: 1047 Games
Publisher: 1047 Games
Release Date: Jun 24, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jun 24, 2026




About This Game

EMPULSE is a fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter where movement is the weapon. Outmove and outgun your opponents across the post-utopian streets of Freehold, chain wall-runs into grapple swings into mid-air kills, and fight for Crews to control mechs for the ultimate power spike.

MOVEMENT IS FREEDOM

Movement is the foundation on EMPULSE. Every district in Freehold is built for chaining movement together and finding your flowstate. Here’s a look at the toolkit:

  • Wall-running: Run forwards and backwards, chain almost any mechanic into a wall-run, and ride virtually every vertical surface on the map.

  • Grapple hook: Build momentum, swing around cover, whip into a wall-run faster than you could on foot, or hook an enemy to reel them in for a one-hit melee.

  • Holojumps and jetpacks: launch off boost pads to keep the movement chain alive.

  • P.A.I.N.T. Bombs: Reshape any surface with Jump, Speed, Explosive, Heal, and Sticky P.A.I.N.T. Bombs to gain the advantage in fights.

Grapple into a wall-run, swing into a Holojump, slide into Speed P.A.I.N.T. In EMPULSE, every move flows into the next

CLAIM THE MECH. CONTROL THE FIGHT.

Mechs are the most contested objective in a match. They act as a power spike that spawns mid-round and forces your team to fight for control. Two of them spawn at the center of the map at a time, and whoever claims one is piloting a machine built to take over a round. A claimed mech comes loaded with a full kit:

  • Chaingun that ramps up the longer you hold the trigger

  • Rockets that delete anyone caught in sight

  • Melee that hits enemies for heavy damage and knocks them back

  • Deployable bubble shield to lock down a position or act as cover

  • Charge jump that launches the mech high into the sky, then slams down with a shockwave, crushing anyone caught underneath on impact

  • Dash to reposition with surprising speed, especially for something so massive

BUILT WITH COMMUNITY - EARLY ACCESS, JUNE 24th

We are shipping in Early Access because the best version of this game is the one we build with you. From day one we will be in the game alongside the community, reading feedback, and shipping updates on a steady cadence based on player insight. Building out in the open lets us move fast and prioritize what players are actually asking for, instead of locking plans to a roadmap set in stone months prior. The more you play, report, and pitch, the better EMPULSE becomes. Here is what that means:

  • A roadmap driven by you , not locked in months ago. Expect new modes, maps, weapons, mechs, and meta playstyles, with plenty more waiting for everyone to discover through playing.

  • Balance and systems tuned with you , not at you. We adjust weapons, mechs, and modes based on how the community actually plays, and we tell you why.

  • Decisions made in the open . We share what we are working on, what we are holding back, and what we are still figuring out, so you can shape it before it ships.

  • No store, no battle pass, no microtransactions at Early Access launch . Period. Cosmetics are earned in-game through Gigs, progression, and events, with non-paid exceptions like Twitch Drops and wishlist incentives.

We’ve taken the game this far. The rest we build together.

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 / Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 470
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
